notes.title: Construction Simulator – Update #14 available now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/ff3a7ad784a5252132ffbe8003e545642e0abea6.jpg

With Update #14 we are excited to bring you new exchangeable parts for the Wacker Neuson ET145 and EW100 excavators, plus a number of bug fixes and general improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. So, pick the perfect bucket for your task and start digging!


Patchnotes - Update #14:

Exchangeable buckets on Wacker Neuson excavators:

 You can change the bucket in the context menu in the new “buckets” section when sitting in the associated machine. The following buckets can now be used on these machines:

 ET145: Backhoe Bucket 600 with Teeth, Backhoe Bucket 900 with Teeth, Ditch cleaning bucket 2000
 EW100: Backhoe Bucket 600 with Teeth, Backhoe Bucket 900 with Teeth, Ditch cleaning bucket 1500


Bugfixes and game improvements:

 Bugfixes regarding Achievements:

 There was a bug that caused Achievements that were dependent on playing time to be unlocked too late or not at all. After a long search, this bug has now been fixed.
 In addition, security checks at the launch of the game have been integrated in the software's background.



 Some PC players were experiencing an issue where they could get stuck in the start screen (press any key) and not being able to start the game. This has to do with a corrupted UserData. A mechanism that recognizes this issue and recreates the UserData after confirmation has been implemented.


 General bugfixes and improvements, among other:

 The voice chat display is now hidden in photo mode.
 A floodlight that was blocking the crane area in an EU single-family home contract was moved.
 Fixed further bugs that caused vehicles to falsely shoot in the air when using fast travel via the map.



 Several minor vehicle fixes and improvements, among other:

 Fixed flying windows on Hamm compactor H11i.
 Fixed the joystick of the JCB 220X excavator clipping through the windshield.



Have fun and stay safe on the construction sites!

Your Construction Simulator team

notes.title: Construction Simulator - Update #11 now available for download!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/3f17bcb0348a12c3a37fe35f0a77795060f627ac.jpg

Good news: We just released Update #11 for Construction Simulator on PC, PlayStation and Xbox! For the first time in the history of the game series, the update opens the possibility to work together with players on other platforms in multiplayer and, if desired, communicate together via the new in-game voice chat. Another new feature are the new emotes for the players' characters! And not to forget: For mobile excavators, it is now possible to switch between driving and functional mode without resetting the body, boom and bucket! And…of course, there are also numerous fixes and general game improvements too!

New Feature: Crossplay Multiplayer
Added crossplay: It is now possible to join multiplayer sessions from any platform – regardless, if you are playing the PC version on Steam, the Microsoft Store version or on PlayStation or Xbox.

 Added option to disable crossplay functionality in the settings under ONLINE. Crossplay is enabled by default for all platforms
 When creating a multiplayer game, crossplay can be enabled or disabled for that particular session


New Feature: Voice Chat
Added voice chat for all platforms: Most related settings can be found under AUDIO > VOICE CHAT (only appears in-game, not in the main menu):

 Option for enabling/disabling voice chat
 Option for changing the audio output and input devices
 Option for setting voice chat volume
 Radio sound effect when players are far away from each other (can be deactivated)
 Possibility to block/unblock communication with other players
 Option for activating/deactivating push-to-talk
 Option to assign the button for push-to-talk under CONTROLS > HUD/MENU. Default key on a keyboard is “Left Alt”


Note: There are still some known issues regarding this new feature. We are working on them and will try to fix them in the future, but we can't make any promises yet.

 Voice chat quality is frame rate dependent and can therefore be poor on last-gen devices

notes.title: Construction Simulator – Update #1 for PC available now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/17a9a6a3a7c0a2031131bbb8fa7dda2572f863e7.png

We just released the first big update for the PC version of Construction Simulator here on Steam. This update introduces an option to skip the tutorial to be able to jump into multiplayer directly, it improves the traffic AI and traffic lights to reduce waiting times at intersections, adds free keybindings for game controllers, and not to forget: numerous fixes and general game improvements. Here are the detailed patch notes:

Patch notes: Update #1 (PC)

General bugfixes and improvements
Graphics polishing
Mission polishing, fixed minor gameplay issues
Tweaked balancing of experience and money in multiplayer
Fixed problem with the UFO cargo in USA map tutorial
Improved traffic system
Fixed speed camera trigger speeds
Traffic lights switch faster now
Localization fixes
Added free keybinding for controllers
Fixed joystick keybindings, so they don’t reset themselves anymore
Tutorial is now skippable
Camera movement with sticks is now possible for Saitek Heavy Equip Farming Sim Controller
Camera controls can now be customized in the controls settings (for gamepads, joysticks and steering wheels)
Added input key for activating the main function of compactors, roadwork machines and concrete mixers (customizable)
Fixes for server region selection in multiplayer
Changed confirmation of profile and company names so no long presses are needed
Partly fixed crashes related to terrain works
Multiple UI fixes
Multiple fixes for restore problems


Your Construction Simulator team

notes.title: Hotfix #1 is available for download!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/567540687248233997d97d9c6bfa7d6a41ebf959.jpg

We just released the Hotfix #1 for Construction Simulator here on Steam. This smaller update includes a fix for the multiplayer server settings, introduces the option to turn the dynamic camera off and a change for the default settings for looking around with the mouse. Here are the patch notes:

Patch notes: Hotfix #1

Implemented an option to turn the Camera Dynamic off (before, it could be set to "low", "medium" and "high" only)
Camera Controls (Mouse): Changing the default setting to "Always", so you can look around with the mouse without having to press or hold a button (can be switched to "Toggle" or "Hold" in the settings menu according your needs). 
Multiplayer: Server fix (next to Europe servers in other regions are now selectable too)


More updates will follow.

Your Construction Simulator team

notes.title: New Construction Simulator to be released in 2022
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42560654/6209fd77c2cf8d566630d26f6d0d67f57bed42ec.jpg

True to the slogan “GET TO WORK”, today we are happy to announce the long-awaited next instalment in the Construction Simulator series. The new Construction Simulator is coming to PC on September 20, 2022 – including a co-op multiplayer, an unprecedented fleet of exciting construction vehicles and machines as well as numerous new and significantly expanded features. Construction Simulator is available for pre-order right now. Look forward to the most extensive and authentic construction simulation of the series to date!

https://youtu.be/0uAgCTBWZVw

Construction Simulator:

Successor to the popular Construction Simulator game series
Most extensive fleet in the game series’ history
Officially licensed vehicles, machines, attachments and workwear from 25 well-known brands
Two huge and completely new maps: EU and US setting, each with an extensive campaign
Entirely revised mission system including a multitude of challenging contracts
Open world with day and night cycle
Improved vehicle and earthmoving system
Officially licensed work clothes
Completely revamped, modern graphics
Co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players
To be released on September 20, 2022 – now available for pre-order!


With its enormous selection of officially licensed vehicles and machines from already known, as well as numerous newly added well-known manufacturers and brands, Construction Simulator not only offers the most extensive fleet in the game series’ history to date, but also countless new features and expanded functions.

In addition to the large number of vehicles, simulation fans and fans of heavy construction machinery may also look forward to two huge and completely new maps, where they can work their way up from a small building contractor to the largest construction giant within the respective region. Regardless if you are playing in the US-American or the European setting: thanks to the completely open game worlds with a dynamic day and night cycle and the entirely revised mission system including its two campaigns as well as a multitude of varied and challenging missions, in Construction Simulator you are free in your decisions on how to lead your company to success.

Next to this, the game will excite you with its completely revamped, modern graphics and an improved vehicle and earthmoving system, as well as a sophisticated cooperative multiplayer mode. Another new feature of Construction Simulator: officially licensed work clothes!

Construction Simulator will be released on September 20, 2022. More detailed information as well as the option to pre-order the game is available here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273400
